claims.statement: complete and stream snapshot RuntimeFlags once, then run the same preflight: prompt compile, optional PII, memory attach, optional second PII pass, optional inbound guards, then catalog resolve and budget or RPM checks.
Streaming refuses response_format, disables Router caching, and holds back 64 characters of PII-redacted SSE unless outbound Llama Guard buffers the full assistant text.
After the provider returns, complete validates structured output when response_format is set and always schedules a background Mem0 record that cannot fail the chat.
